workflow.name: preflight
workflow.retry: Validate legacy schema and check existing workflow fingerprint first. For a fresh attempt persist input and preflight stage, aggregate duplicate SKU quantities in first-appearance order, then check existence and available stock for each product. Retry read-only preflight after temporary failure. Persist draft stage before creating a draft; never run preflight after advancing beyond preflight.
workflow.compensation: None: reads have no business effects. Permanent preflight rejection completes the failed attempt.

workflow.name: draft
workflow.retry: Replay identical body and durable attempt-specific key after ambiguity. Checkpoint order_ref before dependent effects. Draft validates amount only after stock preflight has passed.
workflow.compensation: Rejected draft has no business effects; later permanent failures require void.

workflow.name: reserve
workflow.retry: Replay same order_ref after 503 without repeating preflight; checkpoint acknowledged completion.
workflow.compensation: Persist permanent failure and transition to void.

workflow.name: payment
workflow.retry: Replay identical order_ref, amount, token and durable payment key after 503. Never compensate ambiguous payment.
workflow.compensation: Only permanent rejection transitions to void.

workflow.name: confirm
workflow.retry: Replay idempotently after ambiguity. Checkpoint confirmed result before publishing legacy ID.
workflow.compensation: Void on permanent rejection before reporting the mapped error.

workflow.name: void
workflow.retry: Retain compensation stage and original error durably. Return PENDING on failed void and retry until acknowledged. Cancellation also repeats this idempotent operation safely.
workflow.compensation: Atomic upstream stock release and refund; no further compensation.

plan.idempotency_strategy: Serialize complete requests with ctx.lock. Persist full body fingerprint including payment token, input, attempt generation, upstream keys, reference and workflow stage. Pending or successful keys reject changed bodies; successful replays retrieve current order. Completed failed attempts permit a fresh generation only after required compensation is acknowledged. Preflight runs exclusively in its durable initial stage.
plan.identifier_strategy: Call ctx.id_for only for confirmed workflows or already published orders; resolve legacy IDs via ctx.upstream_id. Failed drafts never receive legacy IDs.
plan.pagination_strategy: Enumerate published mappings sorted by stable legacy integer, slice page and page_size, then fetch current orders. Cap at 10000 mappings and 80 selected orders per request; exceeding either bound returns 503 PENDING without partial success.
limitations: Temporal atomic visibility during pending sagas cannot be preserved; reconciliation requires retry.
Single host only; external writers, shipping, multi-currency, auth migration and noncompensable payments are unsupported.
Listings are bounded to 10000 mappings and 80 selected orders per request.

uncertainties: Matching operationId is a candidate mapping, not proof of behavior.
Atomicity, retry recovery, money and stock effects require docs and bounded probes.
Removed operations plus added primitives may require a one-to-many workflow; semantic evidence required.

limitations: SQLite replay and a disposable PostgreSQL 18.3 integration/restart check were exercised. Docker Compose was not exercised (daemon unavailable).
Single adapter host; global OS lock intentionally serializes requests. No multi-host distributed locking.
V1 temporal atomic visibility cannot be preserved while a V2 saga is pending. 503 PENDING requires same-key retry.
No real money, auth migration, streaming, shipping or external writers. Listings and HTTP calls are bounded.
Codex account reached a usage limit after successful generation/public validation. Later model requests failed and are preserved.
CLI default model identity and monetary cost were not disclosed; token counts and CLI version are recorded where available.
Single-shot baseline was rejected at plan validation; workflows were not executed. One source repair addressed an observed public error-precedence mismatch. No comparative superiority claim is made.
Small deterministic fixture suite, seed 0; these results do not establish correctness for arbitrary APIs.
macOS workers use Seatbelt. Linux bubblewrap fallback shares host networking; Windows untrusted execution fails closed.
